# 数据质量需求配置文件
# Data Quality Requirements Configuration

requirements:
  # S1: 输入规范
  input:
    supported_formats: ["csv", "json", "parquet", "sqlite", "postgresql"]
    encoding: "utf-8"
    max_file_size_mb: 1000
  
  # S2.1: 完整性要求
  completeness:
    min_threshold: 0.95        # 最小完整性95%
    critical_fields:           # 必填字段
      - "id"
      - "created_at"
    allow_empty_strings: false
    
  # S2.2: 准确性要求  
  accuracy:
    outlier_method: "iqr"      # 异常值检测方法: iqr, zscore
    outlier_thre
